reviewer: Codex assistant, separate from packet author
methodology: Read all five complete source snapshots as evidence data, including all 584 lines of historicalAGENTS.
Compared every source byte to git show at exact commit:path; checked SHA256, byte/line counts and last-change Git metadata.
Validated each of 45 citation occurrence against exact 1-based inclusive original lines.
Independently evaluated all 38 atomic criteria for entailment, authority, temporal scope, exceptions, failure classification and qualification boundaries.
For unknowns read the complete closed corpus and cross-checked owner/author/name/resident and seed 29 terms; did not follow linked documents or infer from unrelated measurements.
Bound the latest public answer-contract clarification and Independent-semantic-review wording; neither changed questions or essential criteria.
Read final protocol byte_accounting clarification; successful reader payload cap and rejected-operation accounting do not alter reference entailment or unknown scopes.

questions.finding: Explicit withdrawal, experiment-only lifecycle and the owner-request exception are all directly recorded. The older wording is attributed to an agent reading, not left as an unresolved current rule.
scope_caveats: Does not prove actual present server state.

questions.finding: The overriding authority and reboot authorization are attributed to the owner. The repository record contains no original authenticated human message for this policy; that distinction is supported by inspection of the complete corpus, not by quotation alone.
scope_caveats: Owner is a role attribution, not a verified named author.

questions.finding: Full 16-bit BF16 or runtime FP16 default, both explicit exceptions, and the exclusion of compressed KV from default/headline status are present together in the policy.
scope_caveats: An exception to use compressed KV is not evidence of headline qualification.

questions.finding: CURRENT.md is explicitly designated live-state authority; old notes cannot establish current operation and Git status/process/endpoint checks are expressly required before changes.
scope_caveats: CURRENT.md content is not supplied; no actual live-state answer is implied.

questions.finding: The follow-up directly states incomplete-to-completed million-token progression, incomplete 480K quoted seed1, and preservation of the earlier snapshot. Temporal scope is the described snapshot, not a later campaign outcome.
scope_caveats: The 480K seed1 question count is 21 in the source; do not silently assume 24.

questions.finding: Missing task input is a planning/setup failure without a model score; 35/36 belongs to seed0 and wrapper plan-complete does not mean every cell completed.
scope_caveats: Do not grade setup failure as a zero-accuracy model trial or successful seed1.

questions.finding: 8192 reasoning tokens exhausted the fixed output cap with no answer, expressly bounded-model rather than GPU/transport failure. No retry, cap increase, retrospective completion or held-out admission occurred; future failure handling needs a new protocol and tests.
scope_caveats: The six unstarted rows remain unstarted despite four exact primary trials.

questions.finding: The notes concern different task/protocol comparisons. The single million-token pair supports only its reported 23.0% elapsed observation, not repeat-confirmed speed or intermediate-state guarantees. R4 explicitly disabled prefix caching, records uncached primary trials and quoted slower in both completed pairs, with no qualifying speed verdict.
scope_caveats: Legacy read-mode scored 23/24 versus quoted 24/24; do not claim both were exact.
The separate 480K cache-enabled statement does not establish million-token cache settings.
Quote existence does not replace comparison-identity qualification.

questions.finding: R189 is explicitly published as the R187 line depth profile: R156 via whole-graph R187 wrappers, splitting_ops=[], one slot, tested 2K–32K contexts. MTP1/MTP0 equivalence is supported only at six listed context lengths and tested configuration.
scope_caveats: The R150 real-content protocol and cache-zero qualification are stated in source lines 3–5.
Historical publication is reported by this note; linked publication artifacts are outside the closed corpus.
Context length and speculative-token depth must not be conflated.

questions.finding: R156/splitting_ops=[]/four speculative tokens received the fastest-lossless-single-user-so-far description. First ladder exact through c16, c32=30/32, c64=58/64, weaker high concurrency and queued R201 are all explicit.
scope_caveats: Standing two-run identity rule reinforces that first-ladder exactness is not full concurrency qualification.
No subsequent R201 outcome may be imported.

questions.finding: Null is justified by reading all 725 source lines: owner attribution exists, but no source establishes a named human as author of this specific withdrawal. Hostnames and /home/steve paths do not identify that author, and Git metadata says Codex Agent rather than authenticating original human input.
scope_caveats: Absence is limited to all five supplied documents, not global unknowability.
Relevant citations support the available role attribution; exhaustive corpus review supports absence.

questions.finding: Null is justified across the complete corpus. R4 explicitly says all six seed 29 trials did not start; no other supplied document gives a seed 29 dispatch quoted elapsed measurement. Other seeds, the million-token trial and older R-series timings cannot fill that gap.
scope_caveats: Unstarted is not a measured zero duration.
No claim is made about unprovided later records.

resolved_before_answering.resolution: Parent changed wording to Independent semantic review and refreshed manifest; verified latest hashes.

limitations: This reviewer is independent of packet authorship but has prior involvement in underlying lab work; judgments above are limited to the supplied closed corpus.
The corpus contains agent-curated owner attributions, not authenticated human transcripts. Git equality verifies faithful copying, not historical truth of every claim.
Historical publication and experiment facts are supported as statements in source notes; linked raw evidence is intentionally outside this task.
Absence judgments are corpus-scoped and cannot be certified by a positive quote alone.
Answerer isolation is instruction-based on a shared filesystem, not an enforced sandbox.
Hosted model snapshot/token/cache/monetary costs remain unknown; this reference pass is not model quality, memory-system or speed qualification.
